description: The same workspace change as RT-002, but the plan carries trigger "migration", so review.required is true. The primary run injects no approval at all and must be refused at the GATE with zero agent calls; the second run supplies an explicitly authorized approval and the same change then executes. No approval is hidden, cached, or self-issued.
